title: Why Do the Wicked Have It So Easy? Psalm 73 and the Portion That Outlasts Envy
description: Asaph envied the wicked until he walked into the sanctuary. Psalm 73 shows that the answer to envy is God himself, the portion that outlasts every gift.
deck: When envy makes you doubt that God is good, Psalm 73 points past better circumstances to God himself, the portion that outlasts everything you have ever envied.
hero_alt: A wide mountain valley seen from a high overlook, with forested slopes below and snowy peaks in the distance
hero_caption: “Until I went into the sanctuary of God; then I discerned their end.”
verse_quote: Whom have I in heaven but you? And there is nothing on earth that I desire besides you.
